If you’re using Amazon OpenSearch Service to direct query data in Amazon S3, we also recommend
the following:
• Ingest data into Amazon S3 using partition formats of year, month, day, hour to speed up
queries.
• When you build skipping indexes, use Bloom ﬁlters for ﬁelds with high cardinality and min/max
indexes for ﬁelds with large value ranges. For high-cardinality ﬁelds, consider using a value-
based approach to improve query eﬃciency.
• Use Index State Management to maintain storage for materialized views and covering indexes.

hierarchy.parent: Recommendations for using direct queries in Amazon OpenSearch Service
